an7.38:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass' eva catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya.
an7.38:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘idam me cetaso līnattan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an7.38:1.4: ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘ajjhattaṃ me saṃkhittaṃ cittan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an7.38:1.5: bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘bahiddhā me vikkhittaṃ cittan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an7.38:1.6: Tassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an7.38:1.7: viditā saññā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an7.38:1.8: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an7.38:1.9: sappāyāsappāyesu kho pan' assa dhammesu hīnappaṇītesu kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgesu nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
an7.38:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass' eva catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya. 3.
